datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"
  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
  output   = "../node_modules/.prisma/client"
}

// =============================================================================
// USER & AUTH
// =============================================================================

model User {
  id                  String    @id @default(uuid())
  email               String    @unique
  phone               String?
  passwordHash        String
  role                String    @default("CUSTOMER")
  // SUPER_ADMIN | ADMIN | MANAGER | ACCOUNTANT | CUSTOMER_SUPPORT |
  // MARKETING | WAREHOUSE_MANAGER | INVENTORY_MANAGER | DELIVERY_MANAGER |
  // VENDOR_ADMIN | VENDOR_STAFF | CUSTOMER | RESELLER | DELIVERY_MAN
  status              String    @default("PENDING")
  // PENDING | VERIFIED | ACTIVE | SUSPENDED | BLOCKED | REJECTED | DELETED
  avatar              String?
  twoFactorEnabled    Boolean   @default(false)
  twoFactorSecret     String?
  failedLoginAttempts Int       @default(0)
  lockoutUntil        DateTime?
  lastLoginAt         DateTime?
  emailVerifiedAt     DateTime?
  phoneVerifiedAt     DateTime?
  suspendedAt         DateTime?
  suspendedReason     String?
  createdById         String?   // who created this account
  createdAt           DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime  @updatedAt

  profile             Profile?
  stores              Store[]         @relation("StoreOwner")
  orders              Order[]         @relation("CustomerOrders")
  sessions            Session[]
  devices             Device[]
  loginHistory        LoginHistory[]
  auditLogs           AuditLog[]
  notifications       Notification[]
  notificationPreference NotificationPreference?
  supportTickets      SupportTicket[] @relation("TicketCreator")
  assignedTickets     SupportTicket[] @relation("TicketAssignee")
  walletTransactions  WalletTransaction[]
  loyaltyTransactions LoyaltyTransaction[]
  referrals           Referral[]      @relation("ReferralOwner")
  usedReferral        Referral?       @relation("ReferralUsed")
  userRoles           UserRole[]
  staffMemberships    StaffMember[]   @relation("StaffUser")
  staffManaged        StaffMember[]   @relation("StaffSeller")
  verifications       VerificationRequest[]
  addresses           Address[]

  resellerProfile     ResellerProfile?
  deliveryProfile     DeliveryProfile?
  resellerProducts    ResellerProduct[]   @relation("ResellerCatalog")
  resellerCustomers   ResellerCustomer[]  @relation("ResellerClients")
  resellerOrders      ResellerOrder[]     @relation("ResellerSales")
  deliveryAssignments DeliveryAssignment[] @relation("RiderAssignments")
  assignedDeliveries  DeliveryAssignment[] @relation("AdminAssignments")
  withdrawals         WithdrawalRequest[] @relation("UserWithdrawals")

  walletBalance       Float     @default(0.0)
  loyaltyPoints       Int       @default(0)
  referralCode        String?   @unique
  passwordResetTokens PasswordResetToken[]
}

model Session {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  token     String   @unique
  refreshToken String? @unique
  ipAddress String?
  userAgent String?
  deviceId  String?
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

model Device {
  id           String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId       String
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  fingerprint  String
  name         String?
  browser      String?
  os           String?
  ipAddress    String?
  isTrusted    Boolean  @default(false)
  lastSeenAt   DateTime @default(now())
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([userId, fingerprint])
}

model LoginHistory {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  ipAddress String?
  userAgent String?
  status    String   // SUCCESS | FAILED | LOCKED
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

// =============================================================================
// RBAC — ROLES & PERMISSIONS
// =============================================================================

model Role {
  id          String           @id @default(uuid())
  name        String           @unique
  description String?
  isSystem    Boolean          @default(false) // built-in roles cannot be deleted
  createdAt   DateTime         @default(now())
  permissions RolePermission[]
  userRoles   UserRole[]
}

model Permission {
  id          String           @id @default(uuid())
  key         String           @unique
  // e.g. create:products | view:orders | delete:users | manage:finance
  label       String
  group       String           // Products | Orders | Users | Finance | Settings | etc.
  createdAt   DateTime         @default(now())
  rolePerms   RolePermission[]
}

model RolePermission {
  id           String     @id @default(uuid())
  roleId       String
  role         Role       @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  permissionId String
  permission   Permission @relation(fields: [permissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([roleId, permissionId])
}

model UserRole {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  roleId    String
  role      Role     @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  grantedAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([userId, roleId])
}

// =============================================================================
// PROFILE & ADDRESSES
// =============================================================================

model Profile {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId      String   @unique
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  fullName    String
  dateOfBirth String?
  gender      String?
  nationalId  String?
  bio         String?
  website     String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
}

model Address {
  id         String  @id @default(uuid())
  userId     String
  user       User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  label      String  @default("Home") // Home | Work | Other
  fullName   String
  phone      String
  addressLine1 String
  addressLine2 String?
  city       String
  state      String?
  postalCode String?
  country    String  @default("Bangladesh")
  isDefault  Boolean @default(false)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
}

// =============================================================================
// VERIFICATION REQUESTS
// =============================================================================

model VerificationRequest {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId     String
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type       String   // EMAIL | PHONE_OTP | NATIONAL_ID | TRADE_LICENSE | BUSINESS | BANK_ACCOUNT
  status     String   @default("PENDING") // PENDING | APPROVED | REJECTED
  data       String?  // JSON payload (doc URLs, OTP, etc.)
  reviewNote String?
  reviewedAt DateTime?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
}

// =============================================================================
// SELLER STAFF
// =============================================================================

model StaffMember {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  sellerId    String
  seller      User     @relation("StaffSeller", fields: [sellerId], references: [id])
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation("StaffUser", fields: [userId], references: [id])
  jobTitle    String   // Store Manager | Sales Staff | Inventory Staff | etc.
  permissions String   // JSON array of allowed permission keys
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([sellerId, userId])
}

// =============================================================================
// NOTIFICATIONS
// =============================================================================

model Notification {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId         String
  user           User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  title          String
  body           String
  type           String   @default("INFO") // INFO | SUCCESS | WARNING | ERROR | ORDER | SECURITY
  isRead         Boolean  @default(false)
  link           String?
  priority       String   @default("INFO") // CRITICAL | HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW | INFO
  module         String   @default("MARKETPLACE") // MARKETPLACE | ERP | CRM | HRM | FINANCE | SECURITY | SUPPORT | WALLET
  channels       String   @default("In-App") // In-App, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, etc.
  metadata       String?  // JSON string
  isArchived     Boolean  @default(false)
  isAcknowledged Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
}

model NotificationPreference {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String   @unique
  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  emailEnabled    Boolean  @default(true)
  smsEnabled      Boolean  @default(false)
  pushEnabled     Boolean  @default(true)
  whatsappEnabled Boolean  @default(false)
  telegramEnabled Boolean  @default(false)
  marketingMuted  Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
}

model NotificationRule {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  triggerEvent  String   @unique // e.g. ORDER_DELIVERED, REFUND_APPROVED, WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTED, DELIVERY_ASSIGNED
  actionPayload String   // JSON string containing target roles and channels (e.g. '{"roles":["CUSTOMER","VENDOR_ADMIN"],"channels":["In-App","Email"]}')
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
}

// =============================================================================
// SUPPORT TICKETS
// =============================================================================

model SupportTicket {
  id          String          @id @default(uuid())
  creatorId   String
  creator     User            @relation("TicketCreator", fields: [creatorId], references: [id])
  assigneeId  String?
  assignee    User?           @relation("TicketAssignee", fields: [assigneeId], references: [id])
  subject     String
  description String
  status      String          @default("OPEN") // OPEN | IN_PROGRESS | RESOLVED | CLOSED
  priority    String          @default("NORMAL") // LOW | NORMAL | HIGH | URGENT
  category    String          @default("GENERAL") // ORDER | PAYMENT | ACCOUNT | PRODUCT | GENERAL
  messages    TicketMessage[]
  createdAt   DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime        @updatedAt
}

model TicketMessage {
  id        String        @id @default(uuid())
  ticketId  String
  ticket    SupportTicket @relation(fields: [ticketId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  senderId  String
  body      String
  isStaff   Boolean       @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime      @default(now())
}

// =============================================================================
// WALLET & LOYALTY
// =============================================================================

model WalletTransaction {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type        String   // CREDIT | DEBIT
  amount      Float
  description String
  reference   String?
  balance     Float    // balance after transaction
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
}

model LoyaltyTransaction {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type        String   // EARN | REDEEM | EXPIRE
  points      Int
  description String
  orderId     String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
}

model Referral {
  id         String    @id @default(uuid())
  ownerId    String
  owner      User      @relation("ReferralOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  usedById   String?   @unique
  usedBy     User?     @relation("ReferralUsed", fields: [usedById], references: [id])
  code       String    @unique
  rewardGiven Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt  DateTime  @default(now())
  usedAt     DateTime?
}

// =============================================================================
// STORE & ECOMMERCE (existing extended)
// =============================================================================

model Store {
  id             String      @id @default(uuid())
  name           String      @unique
  logo           String?
  banner         String?
  description    String?
  commissionRate Float       @default(10.00)
  ownerId        String
  owner          User        @relation("StoreOwner", fields: [ownerId], references: [id])
  isApproved     Boolean     @default(false)
  taxInfo        String?     // JSON
  bankInfo       String?     // JSON (encrypted ideally)
  products       Product[]
  warehouses     Warehouse[]
  branches       Branch[]
  orders         Order[]
  suppliers      Supplier[]
  expenses       Expense[]
  createdAt      DateTime    @default(now())
}

model Category {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid())
  name      String    @unique
  slug      String    @unique
  products  Product[]
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
}

model Product {
  id          String           @id @default(uuid())
  storeId     String
  store       Store            @relation(fields: [storeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  categoryId  String
  category    Category         @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id])
  name        String
  description String?
  basePrice   Float
  status      String           @default("PUBLISHED")
  variants    ProductVariant[]
  resellerProducts ResellerProduct[]
  createdAt   DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime         @updatedAt

  @@index([storeId, categoryId])
}

model ProductVariant {
  id         String      @id @default(uuid())
  productId  String
  product    Product     @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  sku        String      @unique
  attributes String
  price      Float       @default(0.00)
  inventory  Inventory[]
  orderItems OrderItem[]
  createdAt  DateTime    @default(now())

  @@index([sku])
}

model Warehouse {
  id        String      @id @default(uuid())
  storeId   String
  store     Store       @relation(fields: [storeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name      String
  location  String?
  inventory Inventory[]
  createdAt DateTime    @default(now())
}

model Branch {
  id        String      @id @default(uuid())
  storeId   String
  store     Store       @relation(fields: [storeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name      String
  city      String
  inventory Inventory[]
  orders    Order[]
  createdAt DateTime    @default(now())
}

model Inventory {
  id           String          @id @default(uuid())
  variantId    String
  variant      ProductVariant  @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  warehouseId  String?
  warehouse    Warehouse?      @relation(fields: [warehouseId], references: [id])
  branchId     String?
  branch       Branch?         @relation(fields: [branchId], references: [id])
  quantity     Int             @default(0)
  reorderPoint Int             @default(10)

  @@index([variantId])
}

model Order {
  id         String      @id @default(uuid())
  customerId String?
  customer   User?       @relation("CustomerOrders", fields: [customerId], references: [id])
  storeId    String
  store      Store       @relation(fields: [storeId], references: [id])
  branchId   String?
  branch     Branch?     @relation(fields: [branchId], references: [id])
  source     String      @default("ONLINE")
  subTotal   Float
  tax        Float
  discount   Float
  total      Float
  status     String      @default("PENDING")
  items      OrderItem[]
  resellerOrder      ResellerOrder?
  deliveryAssignment DeliveryAssignment?
  createdAt  DateTime    @default(now())

  @@index([customerId, storeId])
}

model OrderItem {
  id        String         @id @default(uuid())
  orderId   String
  order     Order          @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  variantId String
  variant   ProductVariant @relation(fields: [variantId], references: [id])
  quantity  Int
  price     Float
}

model CRMClient {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  name       String
  email      String   @unique
  phone      String?
  spentTotal Float    @default(0.00)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
}

model Supplier {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  storeId   String
  store     Store    @relation(fields: [storeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name      String
  email     String?
  phone     String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

model Expense {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  storeId   String
  store     Store    @relation(fields: [storeId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  desc      String
  category  String
  amount    Float
  date      DateTime @default(now())
}

model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String?
  user      User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  action    String
  ipAddress String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([createdAt])
}

// =============================================================================
// COUPON MANAGER
// =============================================================================

model Coupon {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  code      String   @unique
  discount  Float    // percentage e.g. 10 = 10%
  expiry    String   // ISO date string
  active    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

// =============================================================================
// HRM — EMPLOYEES
// =============================================================================

model Employee {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid())
  name       String
  role       String   // Operations Manager | Sales Staff etc.
  dept       String   @default("Administration")
  salary     Float    @default(30000)
  attendance String   @default("100%")
  status     String   @default("Processing") // Paid | Processing | Pending
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
}

// =============================================================================
// CRM NOTES
// =============================================================================

model CRMNote {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  name      String
  note      String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

// =============================================================================
// PASSWORD RESET TOKENS
// =============================================================================

model PasswordResetToken {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  token     String   @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  usedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

// =============================================================================
// WISHLIST
// =============================================================================

model Wishlist {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String
  productId String   // References Product.id
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([userId, productId])
  @@index([userId])
}

// =============================================================================
// RESELLER ECOSYSTEM
// =============================================================================

model ResellerProfile {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId         String   @unique
  user           User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  businessName   String?
  address        String?
  city           String?
  district       String?
  division       String?
  nidNumber      String?
  paymentMethod  String?  // bKash | Nagad | Rocket | Bank Transfer
  paymentNumber  String?
  bankName       String?
  bankAccount    String?
  bankBranch     String?
  status         String   @default("ACTIVE") // PENDING | ACTIVE | SUSPENDED | REJECTED
  rejectReason   String?
  commissionRate Float    @default(5.0)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt
}

model ResellerProduct {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  resellerId     String
  reseller       User     @relation("ResellerCatalog", fields: [resellerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  productId      String
  product        Product  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  resellerPrice  Float?
  resellerMarkup Float?
  isActive       Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([resellerId, productId])
  @@index([resellerId])
  @@index([productId])
}

model ResellerCustomer {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  resellerId  String
  reseller    User     @relation("ResellerClients", fields: [resellerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  name        String
  phone       String
  altPhone    String?
  email       String?
  address     String
  district    String?
  upazila     String?
  city        String?
  notes       String?
  totalOrders Int      @default(0)
  totalSales  Float    @default(0.0)
  totalProfit Float    @default(0.0)
  status      String   @default("ACTIVE")
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([resellerId, phone])
}

model ResellerOrder {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  orderId         String   @unique
  order           Order    @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  resellerId      String
  reseller        User     @relation("ResellerSales", fields: [resellerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  customerName    String
  customerPhone   String
  altPhone        String?
  shippingAddress String
  district        String?
  upazila         String?
  baseAmount      Float
  sellingAmount   Float
  resellerProfit  Float
  platformFee     Float    @default(0.0)
  deliveryFee     Float    @default(0.0)
  status          String   @default("PENDING") // PENDING | CONFIRMED | PROCESSING | PICKED_UP | IN_TRANSIT | DELIVERED | CANCELLED | RETURNED | FAILED
  payoutStatus    String   @default("PENDING") // PENDING | AVAILABLE | PAID | REVERSED
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([resellerId])
  @@index([status])
}

// =============================================================================
// DELIVERY MAN & COURIER ECOSYSTEM
// =============================================================================

model DeliveryProfile {
  id                  String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId              String   @unique
  user                User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  vehicleType         String   @default("BIKE") // BIKE | MOTORCYCLE | CYCLE | VAN | TRUCK | ON_FOOT
  vehicleNumber       String?
  drivingLicense      String?
  nidNumber           String?
  emergencyContact    String?
  division            String?
  district            String?
  upazila             String?
  preferredZone       String?
  currentLat          Float?
  currentLng          Float?
  isOnline            Boolean  @default(false)
  availabilityStatus  String   @default("OFFLINE") // ONLINE | OFFLINE | BUSY | SUSPENDED
  status              String   @default("APPROVED") // PENDING | APPROVED | REJECTED | SUSPENDED
  rejectReason        String?
  completedDeliveries Int      @default(0)
  failedDeliveries    Int      @default(0)
  cashInHand          Float    @default(0.0)
  totalEarnings       Float    @default(0.0)
  createdAt           DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt           DateTime @updatedAt
}

model DeliveryAssignment {
  id            String    @id @default(uuid())
  orderId       String    @unique
  order         Order     @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  deliveryManId String
  deliveryMan   User      @relation("RiderAssignments", fields: [deliveryManId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  assignedById  String?
  assignedBy    User?     @relation("AdminAssignments", fields: [assignedById], references: [id])
  status        String    @default("ASSIGNED") // ASSIGNED | ACCEPTED | REJECTED | PICKED_UP | IN_TRANSIT | DELIVERED | FAILED | RETURNED
  deliveryOtp   String?
  proofNotes    String?
  proofPhoto    String?
  codAmount     Float     @default(0.0)
  codCollected  Boolean   @default(false)
  deliveryFee   Float     @default(120.0)
  assignedAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  acceptedAt    DateTime?
  pickedUpAt    DateTime?
  deliveredAt   DateTime?
  failedAt      DateTime?
  failedReason  String?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@index([deliveryManId])
  @@index([status])
}

// =============================================================================
// UNIVERSAL WITHDRAWAL & PAYOUT SYSTEM
// =============================================================================

model WithdrawalRequest {
  id             String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId         String
  user           User      @relation("UserWithdrawals", fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role           String    // RESELLER | DELIVERY_MAN | VENDOR_ADMIN
  amount         Float
  paymentMethod  String    // bKash | Nagad | Rocket | Bank Transfer
  accountNumber  String
  accountDetails String?
  notes          String?
  status         String    @default("PENDING") // PENDING | APPROVED | PROCESSING | COMPLETED | REJECTED
  adminNote      String?
  transactionRef String?
  processedById  String?
  processedAt    DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([role])
}
